title: SkillCreate
description: Authoring shape for installSkill. The client authors name, description, origin, and execution (I7). The server-owned lifecycle field `status` is forbidden — the server sets it (available|disabled) on install. Server timestamps (created_at, updated_at) are also omitted. metadata and source are optional host-defined provenance the client MAY supply. Sub-schemas are $ref'd from skill.json so they cannot drift. Normative.
